Restraints

You check the key against the lock before closing the irons.

Rules

ID: item-restraints

Market price: 8 coins. Bulk: 1.

Reusable manacles and key. Applying to an unwilling resisting target requires first securing them under the existing restraint rules; purchase grants no grapple or attack.

Buying equipment grants no DP advancement, training or ability. Use normal item-handling actions unless an applicable card says otherwise.
